<h1 id="jellyfin-api">Jellyfin API v1</h1>

> Scroll down for code samples, example requests and responses. Select a language for code samples from the tabs above or the mobile navigation menu.

Base URLs:

* <a href="http://jellyfin.local">http://jellyfin.local</a>

* <a href="http://localhost">http://localhost</a>

# Authentication

* API Key (CustomAuthentication)
    - Parameter Name: **X-Emby-Authorization**, in: header. API key header parameter

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-instantmix">InstantMix</h1>

## Creates an instant playlist based on a given song.

<a id="opIdGetInstantMixFromAlbum"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Albums/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/InstantMix \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Albums/{id}/InstantMix`

<h3 id="creates-an-instant-playlist-based-on-a-given-song-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|enableImages|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

|200|OK|Instant playlist returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|

|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Creates an instant playlist based on a given song.

<a id="opIdGetInstantMixFromArtists"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Artists/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/InstantMix \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Artists/{id}/InstantMix`

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Instant playlist returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Creates an instant playlist based on a given song.

<a id="opIdGetInstantMixFromItem"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Items/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/InstantMix \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/{id}/InstantMix`

<h3 id="creates-an-instant-playlist-based-on-a-given-song-2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|enableImages|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|

## Creates an instant playlist based on a given song.

```bash
curl https://example.com/MusicGenres/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/InstantMix \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication

## Creates an instant playlist based on a given song.

<a id="opIdGetInstantMixFromPlaylist"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Playlists/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/InstantMix \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Playlists/{id}/InstantMix`

<h3 id="creates-an-instant-playlist-based-on-a-given-song-5-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|enableImages|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Instant playlist returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Creates an instant playlist based on a given song.

<a id="opIdGetInstantMixFromSong"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Songs/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/InstantMix \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Songs/{id}/InstantMix`

<h3 id="creates-an-instant-playlist-based-on-a-given-song-6-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|enableImages|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|

## Deletes items from the library and filesystem.

<a id="opIdDeleteItems"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Items \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /Items`

<h3 id="deletes-items-from-the-library-and-filesystem-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ids|query|[string(uuid)]|false|The item ids.|

> Example responses

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "detail": "string",
  "instance": "string",
  "status": 0,
  "title": "string",
  "type": "string",
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
}
```

<h3 id="deletes-items-from-the-library-and-filesystem-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Items deleted.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized access.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Get item counts.

<a id="opIdGetItemCounts"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Items/Counts \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/Counts`

<h3 id="get-item-counts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Get counts from a specific user's library.|
|isFavorite|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Get counts of favorite items.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "AlbumCount": 0,
  "ArtistCount": 0,
  "BookCount": 0,
  "BoxSetCount": 0,
  "EpisodeCount": 0,
  "ItemCount": 0,
  "MovieCount": 0,
  "MusicVideoCount": 0,
  "ProgramCount": 0,
  "SeriesCount": 0,
  "SongCount": 0,
  "TrailerCount": 0
}
```

<h3 id="get-item-counts-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Item counts returned.|[ItemCounts](#schemaitemcounts)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

```bash
curl https://example.com/Items/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \

  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /Items/{itemId}`

<h3 id="deletes-an-item-from-the-library-and-filesystem-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "detail": "string",
  "instance": "string",
  "status": 0,
  "title": "string",
  "type": "string",
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Item parents returned.|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Item not found.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[BaseItemDto](#schemabaseitemdto)]|false|none|none|

CustomAuthentication

## Gets critic review for an item.

<a id="opIdGetCriticReviews"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Items/string/CriticReviews \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/{itemId}/CriticReviews`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

<h3 id="gets-critic-review-for-an-item-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string|true|none|

<h3 id="get-theme-songs-and-videos-for-an-item-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Theme songs and videos returned.|[AllThemeMediaResult](#schemaallthememediaresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Item not found.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Get theme songs for an item.

<a id="opIdGetThemeSongs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Items/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/ThemeSongs \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/{itemId}/ThemeSongs`

<h3 id="get-theme-songs-for-an-item-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|
|inheritFromParent|query|boolean|false|Optional. Determines whether or not parent items should be searched for theme media.|

## Get theme videos for an item.

<a id="opIdGetThemeVideos"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Items/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/ThemeVideos \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/{itemId}/ThemeVideos`

<h3 id="get-theme-videos-for-an-item-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|
|inheritFromParent|query|boolean|false|Optional. Determines whether or not parent items should be searched for theme media.|

```bash
curl https://example.com/Movies/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Similar \
```

<h3 id="gets-similar-items-3-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|excludeArtistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Exclude artist ids.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines, TrailerUrls.|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

|200|OK|Similar items returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets similar items.

<a id="opIdGetSimilarShows"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Shows/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Similar \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Shows/{itemId}/Similar`

<h3 id="gets-similar-items-4-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|excludeArtistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Exclude artist ids.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines, TrailerUrls.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets similar items.

<a id="opIdGetSimilarTrailers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Trailers/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Similar \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Trailers/{itemId}/Similar`

<h3 id="gets-similar-items-5-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|excludeArtistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Exclude artist ids.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines, TrailerUrls.|

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-artists">Artists</h1>

## Gets all artists from a given item, folder, or the entire library.

<a id="opIdGetArtists"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Artists \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Artists`

<h3 id="gets-all-artists-from-a-given-item-folder-or-the-entire-library-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|minCommunityRating|query|number(double) \| null|false|Optional filter by minimum community rating.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|searchTerm|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Search term.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|excludeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered out based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|includeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|filters|query|[[ItemFilter](#schemaitemfilter)]|false|Optional. Specify additional filters to apply.|
|isFavorite|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.|
|mediaTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional filter by MediaType. Allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|genres|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|genreIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|officialRatings|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on OfficialRating. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|tags|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on tag. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|years|query|[integer(int32)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on production year. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional, include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|person|query|string \| null|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person.|
|personIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person ids.|
|personTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, along with Person, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person and PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.|
|studios|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|studioIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|User id.|
|nameStartsWithOrGreater|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.|
|nameStartsWith|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.|
|nameLessThan|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.|
|enableImages|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional, include image information in output.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Total record count.|

|enableUserData|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional, include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|person|query|string \| null|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person.|
|personIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person ids.|
|personTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, along with Person, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person and PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.|
|studios|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|studioIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|User id.|
|nameStartsWithOrGreater|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.|
|nameStartsWith|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.|
|nameLessThan|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.|
|enableImages|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional, include image information in output.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Total record count.|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Album artists returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets an artist by name.

<a id="opIdGetArtistByName"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Artists/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Artists/{name}`

<h3 id="gets-an-artist-by-name-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|path|string|true|Studio name.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-image">Image</h1>

## Get artist image by name.

<a id="opIdGetArtistImage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Artists/string/Images/Primary/0 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /Artists/{name}/Images/{imageType}/{imageIndex}`

<h3 id="get-artist-image-by-name-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|path|string|true|Artist name.|
|imageType|path|[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)|true|Image type.|
|tag|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Supply the cache tag from the item object to receive strong caching headers.|
|format|query|[ImageFormat](#schemaimageformat)|false|Determines the output format of the image - original,gif,jpg,png.|
|maxWidth|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|The maximum image width to return.|
|maxHeight|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|The maximum image height to return.|
|percentPlayed|query|number(double) \| null|false|Optional. Percent to render for the percent played overlay.|
|unplayedCount|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Unplayed count overlay to render.|
|width|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|The fixed image width to return.|
|height|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|The fixed image height to return.|
|quality|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Quality setting, from 0-100. Defaults to 90 and should suffice in most cases.|
|cropWhitespace|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Specify if whitespace should be cropped out of the image. True/False. If unspecified, whitespace will be cropped from logos and clear art.|
|addPlayedIndicator|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Add a played indicator.|
|blur|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Blur image.|
|backgroundColor|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Apply a background color for transparent images.|
|foregroundLayer|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Apply a foreground layer on top of the image.|
|imageIndex|path|integer(int32)|true|Image index.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|imageType|Primary|
|imageType|Art|
|imageType|Backdrop|
|imageType|Banner|
|imageType|Logo|
|imageType|Thumb|
|imageType|Disc|
|imageType|Box|
|imageType|Screenshot|
|imageType|Menu|
|imageType|Chapter|
|imageType|BoxRear|
|imageType|Profile|
|format|Bmp|
|format|Gif|
|format|Jpg|
|format|Png|
|format|Webp|

> Example responses

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "detail": "string",
  "instance": "string",
  "status": 0,
  "title": "string",
  "type": "string",
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
}
```

<h3 id="get-artist-image-by-name-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Image stream returned.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|Item not found.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-dynamichls">DynamicHls</h1>

## Gets a video stream using HTTP live streaming.

<a id="opIdGetHlsAudioSegment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Audio/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/hls1/string/0.string \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Audio/{itemId}/hls1/{playlistId}/{segmentId}.{container}`

<h3 id="gets-a-video-stream-using-http-live-streaming-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|playlistId|path|string|true|The playlist id.|
|segmentId|path|integer(int32)|true|The segment id.|
|container|path|string|true|The video container. Possible values are: ts, webm, asf, wmv, ogv, mp4, m4v, mkv, mpeg, mpg, avi, 3gp, wmv, wtv, m2ts, mov, iso, flv.|
|static|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. If true, the original file will be streamed statically without any encoding. Use either no url extension or the original file extension. true/false.|
|params|query|string \| null|false|The streaming parameters.|
|tag|query|string \| null|false|The tag.|
|deviceProfileId|query|string \| null|false|Optional. The dlna device profile id to utilize.|
|playSessionId|query|string \| null|false|The play session id.|
|segmentContainer|query|string \| null|false|The segment container.|
|segmentLength|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|The segment length.|
|minSegments|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|The minimum number of segments.|
|mediaSourceId|query|string \| null|false|The media version id, if playing an alternate version.|
|deviceId|query|string \| null|false|The device id of the client requesting. Used to stop encoding processes when needed.|
|audioCodec|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Specify a audio codec to encode to, e.g. mp3. If omitted the server will auto-select using the url's extension. Options: aac, mp3, vorbis, wma.|
|enableAutoStreamCopy|query|boolean \| null|false|Whether or not to allow automatic stream copy if requested values match the original source. Defaults to true.|
|allowVideoStreamCopy|query|boolean \| null|false|Whether or not to allow copying of the video stream url.|
|allowAudioStreamCopy|query|boolean \| null|false|Whether or not to allow copying of the audio stream url.|
|breakOnNonKeyFrames|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Whether to break on non key frames.|
|audioSampleRate|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Specify a specific audio sample rate, e.g. 44100.|
|maxAudioBitDepth|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum audio bit depth.|
|maxStreamingBitrate|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum streaming bitrate.|
|audioBitRate|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Specify an audio bitrate to encode to, e.g. 128000. If omitted this will be left to encoder defaults.|
|audioChannels|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Specify a specific number of audio channels to encode to, e.g. 2.|
|maxAudioChannels|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Specify a maximum number of audio channels to encode to, e.g. 2.|
|profile|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Specify a specific an encoder profile (varies by encoder), e.g. main, baseline, high.|
|level|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Specify a level for the encoder profile (varies by encoder), e.g. 3, 3.1.|
|framerate|query|number(float) \| null|false|Optional. A specific video framerate to encode to, e.g. 23.976. Generally this should be omitted unless the device has specific requirements.|
|maxFramerate|query|number(float) \| null|false|Optional. A specific maximum video framerate to encode to, e.g. 23.976. Generally this should be omitted unless the device has specific requirements.|
|copyTimestamps|query|boolean \| null|false|Whether or not to copy timestamps when transcoding with an offset. Defaults to false.|
|startTimeTicks|query|integer(int64) \| null|false|Optional. Specify a starting offset, in ticks. 1 tick = 10000 ms.|
|width|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The fixed horizontal resolution of the encoded video.|
|height|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The fixed vertical resolution of the encoded video.|
|videoBitRate|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Specify a video bitrate to encode to, e.g. 500000. If omitted this will be left to encoder defaults.|
|subtitleStreamIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The index of the subtitle stream to use. If omitted no subtitles will be used.|
|subtitleMethod|query|[SubtitleDeliveryMethod](#schemasubtitledeliverymethod)|false|Optional. Specify the subtitle delivery method.|
|maxRefFrames|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional.|
|maxVideoBitDepth|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum video bit depth.|
|requireAvc|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Whether to require avc.|
|deInterlace|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Whether to deinterlace the video.|
|requireNonAnamorphic|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Whether to require a non anamorphic stream.|
|transcodingMaxAudioChannels|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of audio channels to transcode.|
|cpuCoreLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The limit of how many cpu cores to use.|
|liveStreamId|query|string \| null|false|The live stream id.|
|enableMpegtsM2TsMode|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Whether to enable the MpegtsM2Ts mode.|
|videoCodec|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Specify a video codec to encode to, e.g. h264. If omitted the server will auto-select using the url's extension. Options: h265, h264, mpeg4, theora, vpx, wmv.|
|subtitleCodec|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Specify a subtitle codec to encode to.|
|transcodeReasons|query|string \| null|false|Optional. The transcoding reason.|
|audioStreamIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The index of the audio stream to use. If omitted the first audio stream will be used.|
|videoStreamIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The index of the video stream to use. If omitted the first video stream will be used.|
|context|query|[EncodingContext](#schemaencodingcontext)|false|Optional. The MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna.EncodingContext.|
|streamOptions|query|object \| null|false|Optional. The streaming options.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|subtitleMethod|Encode|
|subtitleMethod|Embed|
|subtitleMethod|External|
|subtitleMethod|Hls|
|context|Streaming|
|context|Static|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

|200|OK|Video stream returned.|Inline|

|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

## Updates capabilities for a device.

<a id="opIdPostCapabilities"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Sessions/Capabilities \
  -X POST \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /Sessions/Capabilities`

<h3 id="updates-capabilities-for-a-device-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|query|string \| null|false|The session id.|
|playableMediaTypes|query|[string]|false|A list of playable media types, comma delimited. Audio, Video, Book, Photo.|
|supportedCommands|query|[[GeneralCommandType](#schemageneralcommandtype)]|false|A list of supported remote control commands, comma delimited.|
|supportsMediaControl|query|boolean|false|Determines whether media can be played remotely..|
|supportsSync|query|boolean|false|Determines whether sync is supported.|
|supportsPersistentIdentifier|query|boolean|false|Determines whether the device supports a unique identifier.|

```bash
curl https://example.com/Channels/Features \
```

## Gets latest channel items.

<a id="opIdGetLatestChannelItems"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Channels/Items/Latest \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Channels/Items/Latest`

<h3 id="gets-latest-channel-items-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. User Id.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|filters|query|[[ItemFilter](#schemaitemfilter)]|false|Optional. Specify additional filters to apply.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|channelIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. Specify one or more channel id's, comma delimited.|

## Get channel items.

<a id="opIdGetChannelItems"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Channels/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Items \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Channels/{channelId}/Items`

<h3 id="get-channel-items-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channelId|path|string(uuid)|true|Channel Id.|
|folderId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Folder Id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. User Id.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|sortOrder|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Sort Order - Ascending,Descending.|
|filters|query|[[ItemFilter](#schemaitemfilter)]|false|Optional. Specify additional filters to apply.|
|sortBy|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-collection">Collection</h1>

## Creates a new collection.

<a id="opIdCreateCollection"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Collections \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /Collections`

<h3 id="creates-a-new-collection-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|query|string \| null|false|The name of the collection.|
|ids|query|[string]|false|Item Ids to add to the collection.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Create the collection within a specific folder.|
|isLocked|query|boolean|false|Whether or not to lock the new collection.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
}
```

<h3 id="creates-a-new-collection-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-genres">Genres</h1>

## Gets all genres from a given item, folder, or the entire library.

<a id="opIdGetGenres"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Genres \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Genres`

<h3 id="gets-all-genres-from-a-given-item-folder-or-the-entire-library-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|searchTerm|query|string \| null|false|The search term.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|excludeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered out based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|includeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered in based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|isFavorite|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|User id.|
|nameStartsWithOrGreater|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.|
|nameStartsWith|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.|
|nameLessThan|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.|
|enableImages|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional, include image information in output.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include total record count.|

<h3 id="gets-all-genres-from-a-given-item-folder-or-the-entire-library-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Genres returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets a genre, by name.

<a id="opIdGetGenre"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Genres/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Genres/{genreName}`

<h3 id="gets-a-genre-by-name-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|genreName|path|string|true|The genre name.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|The user id.|

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-items">Items</h1>

## Gets items based on a query.

<a id="opIdGetItems"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Items \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items`

<h3 id="gets-items-based-on-a-query-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|The user id supplied as query parameter.|
|maxOfficialRating|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by maximum official rating (PG, PG-13, TV-MA, etc).|
|hasThemeSong|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items with theme songs.|
|hasThemeVideo|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items with theme videos.|
|hasSubtitles|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items with subtitles.|
|hasSpecialFeature|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items with special features.|
|hasTrailer|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items with trailers.|
|adjacentTo|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Return items that are siblings of a supplied item.|
|parentIndexNumber|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional filter by parent index number.|
|hasParentalRating|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that have or do not have a parental rating.|
|isHd|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are HD or not.|
|is4K|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are 4K or not.|
|locationTypes|query|[[LocationType](#schemalocationtype)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on LocationType. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|excludeLocationTypes|query|[[LocationType](#schemalocationtype)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on the LocationType. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|isMissing|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are missing episodes or not.|
|isUnaired|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are unaired episodes or not.|
|minCommunityRating|query|number(double) \| null|false|Optional filter by minimum community rating.|
|minCriticRating|query|number(double) \| null|false|Optional filter by minimum critic rating.|
|minPremiereDate|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Optional. The minimum premiere date. Format = ISO.|
|minDateLastSaved|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Optional. The minimum last saved date. Format = ISO.|
|minDateLastSavedForUser|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Optional. The minimum last saved date for the current user. Format = ISO.|
|maxPremiereDate|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum premiere date. Format = ISO.|
|hasOverview|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that have an overview or not.|
|hasImdbId|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that have an imdb id or not.|
|hasTmdbId|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that have a tmdb id or not.|
|hasTvdbId|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that have a tvdb id or not.|
|excludeItemIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered by excluding item ids. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|recursive|query|boolean \| null|false|When searching within folders, this determines whether or not the search will be recursive. true/false.|
|searchTerm|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Filter based on a search term.|
|sortOrder|query|string \| null|false|Sort Order - Ascending,Descending.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines.|
|excludeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|includeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on the item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|filters|query|[[ItemFilter](#schemaitemfilter)]|false|Optional. Specify additional filters to apply. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: IsFolder, IsNotFolder, IsUnplayed, IsPlayed, IsFavorite, IsResumable, Likes, Dislikes.|
|isFavorite|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.|
|mediaTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional filter by MediaType. Allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|imageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on those containing image types. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|sortBy|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.|
|isPlayed|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are played, or not.|
|genres|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|officialRatings|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on OfficialRating. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|tags|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on tag. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|years|query|[integer(int32)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on production year. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional, include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|person|query|string \| null|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person.|
|personIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person id.|
|personTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, along with Person, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person and PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.|
|studios|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|artists|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on artists. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|excludeArtistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on artist id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|artistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified artist id.|
|albumArtistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified album artist id.|
|contributingArtistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified contributing artist id.|
|albums|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on album. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|albumIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on album id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|ids|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specific items are needed, specify a list of item id's to retrieve. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|videoTypes|query|[[VideoType](#schemavideotype)]|false|Optional filter by VideoType (videofile, dvd, bluray, iso). Allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|minOfficialRating|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by minimum official rating (PG, PG-13, TV-MA, etc).|
|isLocked|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are locked.|
|isPlaceHolder|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are placeholders.|
|hasOfficialRating|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that have official ratings.|
|collapseBoxSetItems|query|boolean \| null|false|Whether or not to hide items behind their boxsets.|
|minWidth|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by the minimum width of the item.|
|minHeight|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by the minimum height of the item.|
|maxWidth|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by the maximum width of the item.|
|maxHeight|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by the maximum height of the item.|
|is3D|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are 3D, or not.|
|seriesStatus|query|[[SeriesStatus](#schemaseriesstatus)]|false|Optional filter by Series Status. Allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|nameStartsWithOrGreater|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.|
|nameStartsWith|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.|
|nameLessThan|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.|
|studioIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|genreIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Optional. Enable the total record count.|
|enableImages|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional, include image information in output.|

<h3 id="gets-items-based-on-a-query-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets items based on a query.

<a id="opIdGetItemsByUserId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Users/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Items \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Users/{userId}/Items`

<h3 id="gets-items-based-on-a-query-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string(uuid)|true|The user id supplied as query parameter.|
|maxOfficialRating|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by maximum official rating (PG, PG-13, TV-MA, etc).|
|hasThemeSong|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items with theme songs.|
|hasThemeVideo|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items with theme videos.|
|hasSubtitles|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items with subtitles.|
|hasSpecialFeature|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items with special features.|
|hasTrailer|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items with trailers.|
|adjacentTo|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Return items that are siblings of a supplied item.|
|parentIndexNumber|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional filter by parent index number.|
|hasParentalRating|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that have or do not have a parental rating.|
|isHd|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are HD or not.|
|is4K|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are 4K or not.|
|locationTypes|query|[[LocationType](#schemalocationtype)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on LocationType. This allows multiple, comma delimeted.|
|excludeLocationTypes|query|[[LocationType](#schemalocationtype)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on the LocationType. This allows multiple, comma delimeted.|
|isMissing|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are missing episodes or not.|
|isUnaired|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are unaired episodes or not.|
|minCommunityRating|query|number(double) \| null|false|Optional filter by minimum community rating.|
|minCriticRating|query|number(double) \| null|false|Optional filter by minimum critic rating.|
|minPremiereDate|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Optional. The minimum premiere date. Format = ISO.|
|minDateLastSaved|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Optional. The minimum last saved date. Format = ISO.|
|minDateLastSavedForUser|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Optional. The minimum last saved date for the current user. Format = ISO.|
|maxPremiereDate|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum premiere date. Format = ISO.|
|hasOverview|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that have an overview or not.|
|hasImdbId|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that have an imdb id or not.|
|hasTmdbId|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that have a tmdb id or not.|
|hasTvdbId|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that have a tvdb id or not.|
|excludeItemIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered by exxcluding item ids. This allows multiple, comma delimeted.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|recursive|query|boolean \| null|false|When searching within folders, this determines whether or not the search will be recursive. true/false.|
|searchTerm|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Filter based on a search term.|
|sortOrder|query|string \| null|false|Sort Order - Ascending,Descending.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimeted. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines.|
|excludeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimeted.|
|includeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on the item type. This allows multiple, comma delimeted.|
|filters|query|[[ItemFilter](#schemaitemfilter)]|false|Optional. Specify additional filters to apply. This allows multiple, comma delimeted. Options: IsFolder, IsNotFolder, IsUnplayed, IsPlayed, IsFavorite, IsResumable, Likes, Dislikes.|
|isFavorite|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.|
|mediaTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional filter by MediaType. Allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|imageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on those containing image types. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|sortBy|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimeted. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.|
|isPlayed|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are played, or not.|
|genres|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre. This allows multiple, pipe delimeted.|
|officialRatings|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on OfficialRating. This allows multiple, pipe delimeted.|
|tags|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on tag. This allows multiple, pipe delimeted.|
|years|query|[integer(int32)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on production year. This allows multiple, comma delimeted.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional, include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|person|query|string \| null|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person.|
|personIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person id.|
|personTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, along with Person, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person and PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.|
|studios|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio. This allows multiple, pipe delimeted.|
|artists|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on artists. This allows multiple, pipe delimeted.|
|excludeArtistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on artist id. This allows multiple, pipe delimeted.|
|artistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified artist id.|
|albumArtistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified album artist id.|
|contributingArtistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified contributing artist id.|
|albums|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on album. This allows multiple, pipe delimeted.|
|albumIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on album id. This allows multiple, pipe delimeted.|
|ids|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specific items are needed, specify a list of item id's to retrieve. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|videoTypes|query|[[VideoType](#schemavideotype)]|false|Optional filter by VideoType (videofile, dvd, bluray, iso). Allows multiple, comma delimeted.|
|minOfficialRating|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by minimum official rating (PG, PG-13, TV-MA, etc).|
|isLocked|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are locked.|
|isPlaceHolder|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are placeholders.|
|hasOfficialRating|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that have official ratings.|
|collapseBoxSetItems|query|boolean \| null|false|Whether or not to hide items behind their boxsets.|
|minWidth|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by the minimum width of the item.|
|minHeight|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by the minimum height of the item.|
|maxWidth|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by the maximum width of the item.|
|maxHeight|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by the maximum height of the item.|
|is3D|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are 3D, or not.|
|seriesStatus|query|[[SeriesStatus](#schemaseriesstatus)]|false|Optional filter by Series Status. Allows multiple, comma delimeted.|
|nameStartsWithOrGreater|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.|
|nameStartsWith|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.|
|nameLessThan|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.|
|studioIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio id. This allows multiple, pipe delimeted.|
|genreIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre id. This allows multiple, pipe delimeted.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Optional. Enable the total record count.|
|enableImages|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional, include image information in output.|

## Gets items based on a query.

<a id="opIdGetResumeItems"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Users/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Items/Resume \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Users/{userId}/Items/Resume`

<h3 id="gets-items-based-on-a-query-2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string(uuid)|true|The user id.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|The start index.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|The item limit.|
|searchTerm|query|string \| null|false|The search term.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines.|
|mediaTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. Filter by MediaType. Allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|excludeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|includeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on the item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Optional. Enable the total record count.|
|enableImages|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-filter">Filter</h1>

## Gets legacy query filters.

<a id="opIdGetQueryFiltersLegacy"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Items/Filters \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/Filters`

<h3 id="gets-legacy-query-filters-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. User id.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Parent id.|
|includeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|mediaTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. Filter by MediaType. Allows multiple, comma delimited.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Genres": [
    "string"
  ],
  "OfficialRatings": [
    "string"
  ],
  "Tags": [
    "string"
  ],
  "Years": [
    0
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="gets-legacy-query-filters-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Legacy filters retrieved.|[QueryFiltersLegacy](#schemaqueryfilterslegacy)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets query filters.

<a id="opIdGetQueryFilters"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Items/Filters2 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Items/Filters2`

<h3 id="gets-query-filters-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. User id.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|includeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|isAiring|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Is item airing.|
|isMovie|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Is item movie.|
|isSports|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Is item sports.|
|isKids|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Is item kids.|
|isNews|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Is item news.|
|isSeries|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Is item series.|
|recursive|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Search recursive.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Genres": [
    {
      "Id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "Name": "string"
    }
  ],
  "Tags": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="gets-query-filters-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Filters retrieved.|[QueryFilters](#schemaqueryfilters)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-itemlookup">ItemLookup</h1>

## Applies search criteria to an item and refreshes metadata.

<a id="opIdApplySearchCriteria"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Items/RemoteSearch/Apply/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "AlbumArtist": {},
    "Artists": [
      {}
    ],
    "ImageUrl": "string",
    "IndexNumber": 0,
    "IndexNumberEnd": 0,
    "Name": "string",
    "Overview": "string",
    "ParentIndexNumber": 0,
    "PremiereDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "ProductionYear": 0,
    "ProviderIds": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    },
    "SearchProviderName": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /Items/RemoteSearch/Apply/{itemId}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "AlbumArtist": {},
  "Artists": [
    {}
  ],
  "ImageUrl": "string",
  "IndexNumber": 0,
  "IndexNumberEnd": 0,
  "Name": "string",
  "Overview": "string",
  "ParentIndexNumber": 0,
  "PremiereDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "ProductionYear": 0,
  "ProviderIds": {
    "property1": "string",
    "property2": "string"
  },
  "SearchProviderName": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="applies-search-criteria-to-an-item-and-refreshes-metadata-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|Item id.|
|replaceAllImages|query|boolean|false|Optional. Whether or not to replace all images. Default: True.|
|body|body|[RemoteSearchResult](#schemaremotesearchresult)|true|The remote search result.|
|» AlbumArtist|body|[RemoteSearchResult](#schemaremotesearchresult)|false|none|
|» Artists|body|[[RemoteSearchResult](#schemaremotesearchresult)]|false|none|
|» ImageUrl|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» IndexNumber|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|
|» IndexNumberEnd|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|
|» Name|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the name.|
|» Overview|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» ParentIndexNumber|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|
|» PremiereDate|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|
|» ProductionYear|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the year.|
|» ProviderIds|body|object \| null|false|Gets or sets the provider ids.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» SearchProviderName|body|string \| null|false|none|

<h3 id="applies-search-criteria-to-an-item-and-refreshes-metadata-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Item metadata refreshed.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

<h3 id="gets-available-live-tv-channels-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Available live tv channels returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets a live tv channel.

<a id="opIdGetChannel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/LiveTv/Channels/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /LiveTv/Channels/{channelId}`

<h3 id="gets-a-live-tv-channel-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channelId|path|string(uuid)|true|Channel id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Attach user data.|

CustomAuthentication

## Gets available live tv epgs.

<a id="opIdGetPrograms"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/LiveTv/Programs \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "ChannelIds": [
      "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    ],
    "EnableImageTypes": [
      "Primary"
    ],
    "EnableImages": true,
    "EnableTotalRecordCount": true,
    "EnableUserData": true,
    "Fields": [
      "AirTime"
    ],
    "GenreIds": [
      "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    ],
    "Genres": [
      "string"
    ],
    "HasAired": true,
    "ImageTypeLimit": 0,
    "IsAiring": true,
    "IsKids": true,
    "IsMovie": true,
    "IsNews": true,
    "IsSeries": true,
    "IsSports": true,
    "LibrarySeriesId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "Limit": 0,
    "MaxEndDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "MaxStartDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "MinEndDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "MinStartDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
```

<h3 id="gets-available-live-tv-epgs-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[GetProgramsDto](#schemagetprogramsdto)|false|Request body.|
|» ChannelIds|body|[string(uuid)]|false|Gets or sets the channels to return guide information for.|
|» EnableImageTypes|body|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Gets or sets the image types to include in the output.<br>Optional.|
|» EnableImages|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets include image information in output.<br>Optional.|
|» EnableTotalRecordCount|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether retrieve total record count.|
|» EnableUserData|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets include user data.<br>Optional.|
|» Fields|body|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Gets or sets specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines.<br>Optional.|
|» GenreIds|body|[string(uuid)]|false|Gets or sets the genre ids to return guide information for.|
|» Genres|body|[string]|false|Gets or sets the genres to return guide information for.|
|» HasAired|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets filter by programs that have completed airing, or not.<br>Optional.|
|» ImageTypeLimit|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the max number of images to return, per image type.<br>Optional.|
|» IsAiring|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets filter by programs that are currently airing, or not.<br>Optional.|
|» IsKids|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets filter for kids.<br>Optional.|
|» IsMovie|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets filter for movies.<br>Optional.|
|» IsNews|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets filter for news.<br>Optional.|
|» IsSeries|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets filter for series.<br>Optional.|
|» IsSports|body|boolean \| null|false|Gets or sets filter for sports.<br>Optional.|
|» LibrarySeriesId|body|string(uuid)|false|Gets or sets filter by library series id.<br>Optional.|
|» Limit|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the maximum number of records to return.<br>Optional.|
|» MaxEndDate|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|Gets or sets the maximum premiere end date.<br>Optional.|
|» MaxStartDate|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|Gets or sets the maximum premiere start date.<br>Optional.|
|» MinEndDate|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|Gets or sets the minimum premiere end date.<br>Optional.|
|» MinStartDate|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|Gets or sets the minimum premiere start date.<br>Optional.|
|» SeriesTimerId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets filter by series timer id.<br>Optional.|
|» SortBy|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Name, StartDate.<br>Optional.|
|» SortOrder|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets sort Order - Ascending,Descending.|
|» StartIndex|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.<br>Optional.|
|» UserId|body|string(uuid)|false|Gets or sets optional. Filter by user id.|

<h3 id="gets-available-live-tv-epgs-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Live tv epgs returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets recommended live tv epgs.

<a id="opIdGetRecommendedPrograms"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/LiveTv/Programs/Recommended \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /LiveTv/Programs/Recommended`

<h3 id="gets-recommended-live-tv-epgs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. filter by user id.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|isAiring|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Filter by programs that are currently airing, or not.|
|hasAired|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Filter by programs that have completed airing, or not.|
|isSeries|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Filter for series.|
|isMovie|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Filter for movies.|
|isNews|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Filter for news.|
|isKids|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Filter for kids.|
|isSports|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Filter for sports.|
|enableImages|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|genreIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|The genres to return guide information for.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. include user data.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Retrieve total record count.|

## Gets live tv recordings.

<a id="opIdGetRecordings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/LiveTv/Recordings \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /LiveTv/Recordings`

<h3 id="gets-live-tv-recordings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channelId|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Filter by channel id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by user and attach user data.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|status|query|[RecordingStatus](#schemarecordingstatus)|false|Optional. Filter by recording status.|
|isInProgress|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Filter by recordings that are in progress, or not.|
|seriesTimerId|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Filter by recordings belonging to a series timer.|
|enableImages|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include user data.|
|isMovie|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Filter for movies.|
|isSeries|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Filter for series.|
|isKids|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Filter for kids.|
|isSports|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Filter for sports.|
|isNews|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Filter for news.|
|isLibraryItem|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Filter for is library item.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Optional. Return total record count.|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

|200|OK|Live tv recordings returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets recording folders.

<a id="opIdGetRecordingFolders"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/LiveTv/Recordings/Folders \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /LiveTv/Recordings/Folders`

<h3 id="gets-recording-folders-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by user and attach user data.|
