<h3 id="gets-live-tv-recording-series-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channelId|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Filter by channel id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by user and attach user data.|
|groupId|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Filter by recording group.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|status|query|[RecordingStatus](#schemarecordingstatus)|false|Optional. Filter by recording status.|
|isInProgress|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Filter by recordings that are in progress, or not.|
|seriesTimerId|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Filter by recordings belonging to a series timer.|
|enableImages|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include user data.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Optional. Return total record count.|

<h3 id="gets-live-tv-recording-series-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Live tv recordings returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets a live tv recording.

<a id="opIdGetRecording"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/LiveTv/Recordings/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /LiveTv/Recordings/{recordingId}`

<h3 id="gets-a-live-tv-recording-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|recordingId|path|string(uuid)|true|Recording id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Attach user data.|

|» ParentBackdropItemId|body|string \| null|false|If the item does not have any backdrops, this will hold the Id of the Parent that has one.|
|» ParentPrimaryImageItemId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the parent primary image item identifier.|
|» ParentPrimaryImageTag|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the parent primary image tag.|
|» ParentThumbImageTag|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the parent thumb image tag.|
|» ParentThumbItemId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the parent thumb item id.|
|» PostPaddingSeconds|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the post padding seconds.|
|» PrePaddingSeconds|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the pre padding seconds.|
|» Priority|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the priority.|
|» ProgramId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the program identifier.|
|» RecordAnyChannel|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether [record any channel].|
|» RecordAnyTime|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether [record any time].|
|» RecordNewOnly|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether [record new only].|
|» ServerId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the server identifier.|
|» ServiceName|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the name of the service.|
|» SkipEpisodesInLibrary|body|boolean|false|none|
|» StartDate|body|string(date-time)|false|The start date of the recording, in UTC.|
|» Type|body|string \| null|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» DayPattern|Daily|
|» DayPattern|Weekdays|
|» DayPattern|Weekends|
|» Days|Sunday|
|» Days|Monday|
|» Days|Tuesday|
|» Days|Wednesday|
|» Days|Thursday|
|» Days|Friday|
|» Days|Saturday|
|» KeepUntil|UntilDeleted|
|» KeepUntil|UntilSpaceNeeded|
|» KeepUntil|UntilWatched|
|» KeepUntil|UntilDate|

## Cancels a live tv series timer.

<a id="opIdCancelSeriesTimer"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/LiveTv/SeriesTimers/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /LiveTv/SeriesTimers/{timerId}`

<h3 id="cancels-a-live-tv-series-timer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|timerId|path|string|true|Timer id.|

<h3 id="cancels-a-live-tv-series-timer-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Timer cancelled.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets the live tv timers.

<a id="opIdGetTimers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/LiveTv/Timers \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /LiveTv/Timers`

<h3 id="gets-the-live-tv-timers-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channelId|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Filter by channel id.|
|seriesTimerId|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Filter by timers belonging to a series timer.|
|isActive|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Filter by timers that are active.|
|isScheduled|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Filter by timers that are scheduled.|

<h3 id="creates-a-live-tv-timer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[TimerInfoDto](#schematimerinfodto)|false|New timer info.|
|» ChannelId|body|string(uuid)|false|ChannelId of the recording.|
|» ChannelName|body|string \| null|false|ChannelName of the recording.|
|» ChannelPrimaryImageTag|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» EndDate|body|string(date-time)|false|The end date of the recording, in UTC.|
|» ExternalChannelId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the external channel identifier.|
|» ExternalId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the external identifier.|
|» ExternalProgramId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the external program identifier.|
|» ExternalSeriesTimerId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the external series timer identifier.|
|» Id|body|string \| null|false|Id of the recording.|
|» IsPostPaddingRequired|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is post padding required.|
|» IsPrePaddingRequired|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is pre padding required.|
|» KeepUntil|body|[KeepUntil](#schemakeepuntil)|false|none|
|» Name|body|string \| null|false|Name of the recording.|
|» Overview|body|string \| null|false|Description of the recording.|
|» ParentBackdropImageTags|body|[string]|false|Gets or sets the parent backdrop image tags.|
|» ParentBackdropItemId|body|string \| null|false|If the item does not have any backdrops, this will hold the Id of the Parent that has one.|
|» PostPaddingSeconds|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the post padding seconds.|
|» PrePaddingSeconds|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the pre padding seconds.|
|» Priority|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the priority.|
|» ProgramId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the program identifier.|
|» ProgramInfo|body|[BaseItemDto](#schemabaseitemdto)|false|This is strictly used as a data transfer object from the api layer.<br>This holds information about a BaseItem in a format that is convenient for the client.|
|» RunTimeTicks|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|Gets or sets the run time ticks.|
|» SeriesTimerId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the series timer identifier.|
|» ServerId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the server identifier.|
|» ServiceName|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the name of the service.|
|» StartDate|body|string(date-time)|false|The start date of the recording, in UTC.|
|» Status|body|[RecordingStatus](#schemarecordingstatus)|false|none|
|» Type|body|string \| null|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» KeepUntil|UntilDeleted|
|» KeepUntil|UntilSpaceNeeded|
|» KeepUntil|UntilWatched|
|» KeepUntil|UntilDate|
|» Status|New|
|» Status|InProgress|
|» Status|Completed|
|» Status|Cancelled|
|» Status|ConflictedOk|
|» Status|ConflictedNotOk|
|» Status|Error|

<h3 id="creates-a-live-tv-timer-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Timer created.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

</aside>

|» PrePaddingSeconds|body|integer(int32)|false|Gets or sets the pre padding seconds.|

|» ProgramId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the program identifier.|

|» StartDate|body|string(date-time)|false|The start date of the recording, in UTC.|

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[RecommendationDto](#schemarecommendationdto)]|false|none|none|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-musicgenres">MusicGenres</h1>

## Gets all music genres from a given item, folder, or the entire library.

<a id="opIdGetMusicGenres"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/MusicGenres \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /MusicGenres`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

<h3 id="gets-all-music-genres-from-a-given-item-folder-or-the-entire-library-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|searchTerm|query|string \| null|false|The search term.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|excludeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered out based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|includeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered in based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|isFavorite|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|User id.|
|nameStartsWithOrGreater|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.|
|nameStartsWith|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.|
|nameLessThan|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.|
|enableImages|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional, include image information in output.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Optional. Include total record count.|

## Gets a music genre, by name.

<a id="opIdGetMusicGenre"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/MusicGenres/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /MusicGenres/{genreName}`

<h3 id="gets-a-music-genre-by-name-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|genreName|path|string|true|The genre name.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|

## Sends a notification to all admins.

<a id="opIdCreateAdminNotification"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Notifications/Admin \
```

## Gets all persons.

<a id="opIdGetPersons"></a>

```bash
curl https://example.com/Persons \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Persons`

<h3 id="gets-all-persons-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|searchTerm|query|string \| null|false|The search term.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|filters|query|[[ItemFilter](#schemaitemfilter)]|false|Optional. Specify additional filters to apply.|
|isFavorite|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not. userId is required.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional, include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|excludePersonTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified results will be filtered to exclude those containing the specified PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.|
|personTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.|
|appearsInItemId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. If specified, person results will be filtered on items related to said persons.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|User id.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Get person by name.

<a id="opIdGetPerson"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Persons/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Persons/{name}`

<h3 id="get-person-by-name-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|path|string|true|Person name.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|

|404|Not Found|Person not found.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-playlists">Playlists</h1>

## Creates a new playlist.

<a id="opIdCreatePlaylist"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Playlists \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "Ids": [
      "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    ],
    "MediaType": "string",
    "Name": "string",
    "UserId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  }'
```

`POST /Playlists`

For backwards compatibility parameters can be sent via Query or Body, with Query having higher precedence.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "Ids": [
    "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  ],
  "MediaType": "string",
  "Name": "string",
  "UserId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
}
```

<h3 id="creates-a-new-playlist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|query|string \| null|false|The playlist name.|
|ids|query|[string(uuid)]|false|The item ids.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|The user id.|
|mediaType|query|string \| null|false|The media type.|
|body|body|[CreatePlaylistDto](#schemacreateplaylistdto)|false|The create playlist payload.|
|» Ids|body|[string(uuid)]|false|Gets or sets item ids to add to the playlist.|
|» MediaType|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the media type.|
|» Name|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the name of the new playlist.|
|» UserId|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Gets or sets the user id.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="creates-a-new-playlist-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success|[PlaylistCreationResult](#schemaplaylistcreationresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets the original items of a playlist.

<a id="opIdGetPlaylistItems"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/Playlists/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Items?userId=497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Playlists/{playlistId}/Items`

<h3 id="gets-the-original-items-of-a-playlist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|playlistId|path|string(uuid)|true|The playlist id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid)|true|User id.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|enableImages|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|

```bash
curl https://example.com/ScheduledTasks/string/Triggers \
```

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-search">Search</h1>

## Gets the search hint result.

<a id="opIdGet"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/Search/Hints?searchTerm=string' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Search/Hints`

<h3 id="gets-the-search-hint-result-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Supply a user id to search within a user's library or omit to search all.|
|searchTerm|query|string|true|The search term to filter on.|
|includeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|If specified, only results with the specified item types are returned. This allows multiple, comma delimeted.|
|excludeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|If specified, results with these item types are filtered out. This allows multiple, comma delimeted.|
|mediaTypes|query|[string]|false|If specified, only results with the specified media types are returned. This allows multiple, comma delimeted.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|If specified, only children of the parent are returned.|
|isMovie|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter for movies.|
|isSeries|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter for series.|
|isNews|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter for news.|
|isKids|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter for kids.|
|isSports|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter for sports.|
|includePeople|query|boolean|false|Optional filter whether to include people.|
|includeMedia|query|boolean|false|Optional filter whether to include media.|
|includeGenres|query|boolean|false|Optional filter whether to include genres.|
|includeStudios|query|boolean|false|Optional filter whether to include studios.|
|includeArtists|query|boolean|false|Optional filter whether to include artists.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "SearchHints": [
    {
      "Album": "string",
      "AlbumArtist": "string",
      "AlbumId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",

        "string"
      ],
      "BackdropImageItemId": "string",
```

<h3 id="reports-playback-has-started-within-a-session-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[PlaybackStartInfo](#schemaplaybackstartinfo)|false|The playback start info.|
|» AspectRatio|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» AudioStreamIndex|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the index of the audio stream.|
|» Brightness|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|
|» CanSeek|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance can seek.|
|» IsMuted|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is muted.|
|» IsPaused|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is paused.|
|» Item|body|[BaseItemDto](#schemabaseitemdto)|false|This is strictly used as a data transfer object from the api layer.<br>This holds information about a BaseItem in a format that is convenient for the client.|
|» ItemId|body|string(uuid)|false|Gets or sets the item identifier.|
|» LiveStreamId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the live stream identifier.|
|» MediaSourceId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the media version identifier.|
|» NowPlayingQueue|body|[[QueueItem](#schemaqueueitem)]|false|none|
|» PlayMethod|body|[PlayMethod](#schemaplaymethod)|false|none|
|» PlaySessionId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the play session identifier.|
|» PlaybackStartTimeTicks|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|
|» PlaylistItemId|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» PositionTicks|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|Gets or sets the position ticks.|
|» RepeatMode|body|[RepeatMode](#schemarepeatmode)|false|none|
|» SessionId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the session id.|
|» SubtitleStreamIndex|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the index of the subtitle stream.|
|» VolumeLevel|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the volume level.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» PlayMethod|Transcode|
|» PlayMethod|DirectStream|
|» PlayMethod|DirectPlay|
|» RepeatMode|RepeatNone|
|» RepeatMode|RepeatAll|
|» RepeatMode|RepeatOne|

<h3 id="reports-playback-has-started-within-a-session-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Playback start recorded.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Pings a playback session.

<a id="opIdPingPlaybackSession"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Sessions/Playing/Ping \
  -X POST \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /Sessions/Playing/Ping`

<h3 id="pings-a-playback-session-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|playSessionId|query|string \| null|false|Playback session id.|

<h3 id="pings-a-playback-session-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Playback session pinged.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

<h3 id="reports-playback-progress-within-a-session-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[PlaybackProgressInfo](#schemaplaybackprogressinfo)|false|The playback progress info.|
|» AspectRatio|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» AudioStreamIndex|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the index of the audio stream.|
|» Brightness|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|
|» CanSeek|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance can seek.|
|» IsMuted|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is muted.|
|» IsPaused|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is paused.|
|» Item|body|[BaseItemDto](#schemabaseitemdto)|false|This is strictly used as a data transfer object from the api layer.<br>This holds information about a BaseItem in a format that is convenient for the client.|
|» ItemId|body|string(uuid)|false|Gets or sets the item identifier.|
|» LiveStreamId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the live stream identifier.|
|» MediaSourceId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the media version identifier.|
|» NowPlayingQueue|body|[[QueueItem](#schemaqueueitem)]|false|none|
|» PlayMethod|body|[PlayMethod](#schemaplaymethod)|false|none|
|» PlaySessionId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the play session identifier.|
|» PlaybackStartTimeTicks|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|
|» PlaylistItemId|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» PositionTicks|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|Gets or sets the position ticks.|
|» RepeatMode|body|[RepeatMode](#schemarepeatmode)|false|none|
|» SessionId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the session id.|
|» SubtitleStreamIndex|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the index of the subtitle stream.|
|» VolumeLevel|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Gets or sets the volume level.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» PlayMethod|Transcode|
|» PlayMethod|DirectStream|
|» PlayMethod|DirectPlay|
|» RepeatMode|RepeatNone|
|» RepeatMode|RepeatAll|
|» RepeatMode|RepeatOne|

<h3 id="reports-playback-progress-within-a-session-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Playback progress recorded.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

|» LiveStreamId|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the live stream identifier.|

|» PlaylistItemId|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» PositionTicks|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|Gets or sets the position ticks.|

## Marks an item as played for user.

<a id="opIdMarkPlayedItem"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Users/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/PlayedItems/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /Users/{userId}/PlayedItems/{itemId}`

<h3 id="marks-an-item-as-played-for-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string(uuid)|true|User id.|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|Item id.|
|datePlayed|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Optional. The date the item was played.|

```json
  "PlayCount": 0,
  "PlaybackPositionTicks": 0,
  "Played": true,
  "PlayedPercentage": 0,
  "Rating": 0,
  "UnplayedItemCount": 0
```

|---|---|---|---|

|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

CustomAuthentication
</aside>

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-tvshows">TvShows</h1>

## Gets a list of next up episodes.

<a id="opIdGetNextUp"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Shows/NextUp \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Shows/NextUp`

<h3 id="gets-a-list-of-next-up-episodes-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|The user id of the user to get the next up episodes for.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|seriesId|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Filter by series id.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|enableImges|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include user data.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Whether to enable the total records count. Defaults to true.|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets a list of upcoming episodes.

<a id="opIdGetUpcomingEpisodes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Shows/Upcoming \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Shows/Upcoming`

<h3 id="gets-a-list-of-upcoming-episodes-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|The user id of the user to get the upcoming episodes for.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|enableImges|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include image information in output.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Include user data.|

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-startup">Startup</h1>

## Completes the startup wizard.

<a id="opIdCompleteWizard"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Startup/Complete \
  -X POST \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /Startup/Complete`

<h3 id="completes-the-startup-wizard-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Startup wizard completed.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets the initial startup wizard configuration.

<a id="opIdGetStartupConfiguration"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Startup/Configuration \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Startup/Configuration`

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "MetadataCountryCode": "string",
  "PreferredMetadataLanguage": "string",
  "UICulture": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="gets-the-initial-startup-wizard-configuration-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Initial startup wizard configuration retrieved.|[StartupConfigurationDto](#schemastartupconfigurationdto)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Sets the initial startup wizard configuration.

<a id="opIdUpdateInitialConfiguration"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Startup/Configuration \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "MetadataCountryCode": "string",
    "PreferredMetadataLanguage": "string",
    "UICulture": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /Startup/Configuration`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "MetadataCountryCode": "string",
  "PreferredMetadataLanguage": "string",
  "UICulture": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="sets-the-initial-startup-wizard-configuration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[StartupConfigurationDto](#schemastartupconfigurationdto)|true|The updated startup configuration.|
|» MetadataCountryCode|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the metadata country code.|
|» PreferredMetadataLanguage|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the preferred language for the metadata.|
|» UICulture|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets UI language culture.|

<h3 id="sets-the-initial-startup-wizard-configuration-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Configuration saved.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Sets remote access and UPnP.

<a id="opIdSetRemoteAccess"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Startup/RemoteAccess \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "EnableAutomaticPortMapping": true,
    "EnableRemoteAccess": true
  }'
```

```json
  "EnableAutomaticPortMapping": true,
  "EnableRemoteAccess": true
}
```

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-studios">Studios</h1>

## Gets all studios from a given item, folder, or the entire library.

<a id="opIdGetStudios"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Studios \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Studios`

<h3 id="gets-all-studios-from-a-given-item-folder-or-the-entire-library-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|searchTerm|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Search term.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|excludeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered out based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|includeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|isFavorite|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional, include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|User id.|
|nameStartsWithOrGreater|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.|
|nameStartsWith|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.|
|nameLessThan|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.|
|enableImages|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional, include image information in output.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Total record count.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|fields|AirTime|
|fields|CanDelete|
|fields|CanDownload|
|fields|ChannelInfo|
|fields|Chapters|
|fields|ChildCount|
|fields|CumulativeRunTimeTicks|
|fields|CustomRating|
|fields|DateCreated|
|fields|DateLastMediaAdded|
|fields|DisplayPreferencesId|
|fields|Etag|
|fields|ExternalUrls|
|fields|Genres|
|fields|HomePageUrl|
|fields|ItemCounts|
|fields|MediaSourceCount|
|fields|MediaSources|
|fields|OriginalTitle|
|fields|Overview|
|fields|ParentId|
|fields|Path|
|fields|People|
|fields|PlayAccess|

<h3 id="gets-all-studios-from-a-given-item-folder-or-the-entire-library-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Studios returned.|[BaseItemDtoQueryResult](#schemabaseitemdtoqueryresult)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets a studio by name.

<a id="opIdGetStudio"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Studios/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Studios/{name}`

<h3 id="gets-a-studio-by-name-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|path|string|true|Studio name.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-syncplay">SyncPlay</h1>

## Notify SyncPlay group that member is buffering.

<a id="opIdSyncPlayBuffering"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/SyncPlay/Buffering \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "IsPlaying": true,
    "PlaylistItemId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "PositionTicks": 0,
    "When": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  }'
```

`POST /SyncPlay/Buffering`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "IsPlaying": true,
  "PlaylistItemId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "PositionTicks": 0,
  "When": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<h3 id="notify-syncplay-group-that-member-is-buffering-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[BufferRequestDto](#schemabufferrequestdto)|true|The player status.|
|» IsPlaying|body|boolean|false|Gets or sets a value indicating whether the client playback is unpaused.|
|» PlaylistItemId|body|string(uuid)|false|Gets or sets the playlist item identifier of the playing item.|
|» PositionTicks|body|integer(int64)|false|Gets or sets the position ticks.|
|» When|body|string(date-time)|false|Gets or sets when the request has been made by the client.|

<h3 id="notify-syncplay-group-that-member-is-buffering-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Group state update sent to all group members.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

<h3 id="gets-activity-log-entries-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|minDate|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Optional. The minimum date. Format = ISO.|
|hasUserId|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. Filter log entries if it has user id, or not.|

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Items": [
    {
      "Date": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "Id": 0,
      "ItemId": "string",
      "Name": "string",
      "Overview": "string",
      "Severity": "Trace",
      "ShortOverview": "string",
      "Type": "string",
      "UserId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "UserPrimaryImageTag": "string"
    }
  ],
  "StartIndex": 0,
  "TotalRecordCount": 0
}
```

|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-trailers">Trailers</h1>

## Finds movies and trailers similar to a given trailer.

<a id="opIdGetTrailers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Trailers \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Trailers`

<h3 id="finds-movies-and-trailers-similar-to-a-given-trailer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|The user id.|
|maxOfficialRating|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by maximum official rating (PG, PG-13, TV-MA, etc).|
|hasThemeSong|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items with theme songs.|
|hasThemeVideo|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items with theme videos.|
|hasSubtitles|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items with subtitles.|
|hasSpecialFeature|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items with special features.|
|hasTrailer|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items with trailers.|
|adjacentTo|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Return items that are siblings of a supplied item.|
|parentIndexNumber|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional filter by parent index number.|
|hasParentalRating|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that have or do not have a parental rating.|
|isHd|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are HD or not.|
|is4K|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are 4K or not.|
|locationTypes|query|[[LocationType](#schemalocationtype)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on LocationType. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|excludeLocationTypes|query|[[LocationType](#schemalocationtype)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on the LocationType. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|isMissing|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are missing episodes or not.|
|isUnaired|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are unaired episodes or not.|
|minCommunityRating|query|number(double) \| null|false|Optional filter by minimum community rating.|
|minCriticRating|query|number(double) \| null|false|Optional filter by minimum critic rating.|
|minPremiereDate|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Optional. The minimum premiere date. Format = ISO.|
|minDateLastSaved|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Optional. The minimum last saved date. Format = ISO.|
|minDateLastSavedForUser|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Optional. The minimum last saved date for the current user. Format = ISO.|
|maxPremiereDate|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum premiere date. Format = ISO.|
|hasOverview|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that have an overview or not.|
|hasImdbId|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that have an imdb id or not.|
|hasTmdbId|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that have a tmdb id or not.|
|hasTvdbId|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that have a tvdb id or not.|
|excludeItemIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered by excluding item ids. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The maximum number of records to return.|
|recursive|query|boolean \| null|false|When searching within folders, this determines whether or not the search will be recursive. true/false.|
|searchTerm|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Filter based on a search term.|
|sortOrder|query|string \| null|false|Sort Order - Ascending,Descending.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines.|
|excludeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|filters|query|[[ItemFilter](#schemaitemfilter)]|false|Optional. Specify additional filters to apply. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: IsFolder, IsNotFolder, IsUnplayed, IsPlayed, IsFavorite, IsResumable, Likes, Dislikes.|
|isFavorite|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.|
|mediaTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional filter by MediaType. Allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|imageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on those containing image types. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|sortBy|query|string \| null|false|Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Album, AlbumArtist, Artist, Budget, CommunityRating, CriticRating, DateCreated, DatePlayed, PlayCount, PremiereDate, ProductionYear, SortName, Random, Revenue, Runtime.|
|isPlayed|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are played, or not.|
|genres|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|officialRatings|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on OfficialRating. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|tags|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on tag. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|years|query|[integer(int32)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on production year. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional, include user data.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|person|query|string \| null|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person.|
|personIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person id.|
|personTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, along with Person, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person and PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.|
|studios|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|artists|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on artists. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|excludeArtistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on artist id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|artistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified artist id.|
|albumArtistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified album artist id.|
|contributingArtistIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified contributing artist id.|
|albums|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on album. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|albumIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on album id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|ids|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specific items are needed, specify a list of item id's to retrieve. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|videoTypes|query|[[VideoType](#schemavideotype)]|false|Optional filter by VideoType (videofile, dvd, bluray, iso). Allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|minOfficialRating|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by minimum official rating (PG, PG-13, TV-MA, etc).|
|isLocked|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are locked.|
|isPlaceHolder|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are placeholders.|
|hasOfficialRating|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that have official ratings.|
|collapseBoxSetItems|query|boolean \| null|false|Whether or not to hide items behind their boxsets.|
|minWidth|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by the minimum width of the item.|
|minHeight|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by the minimum height of the item.|
|maxWidth|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by the maximum width of the item.|
|maxHeight|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by the maximum height of the item.|
|is3D|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by items that are 3D, or not.|
|seriesStatus|query|[[SeriesStatus](#schemaseriesstatus)]|false|Optional filter by Series Status. Allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|nameStartsWithOrGreater|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.|
|nameStartsWith|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.|
|nameLessThan|query|string \| null|false|Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.|
|studioIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|genreIds|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.|
|enableTotalRecordCount|query|boolean|false|Optional. Enable the total record count.|
|enableImages|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional, include image information in output.|

CustomAuthentication

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-user">User</h1>

## Gets a list of users.

<a id="opIdGetUsers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Users \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Users`

<h3 id="gets-a-list-of-users-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|isHidden|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by IsHidden=true or false.|
|isDisabled|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional filter by IsDisabled=true or false.|

CustomAuthentication

## Authenticates a user by name.

<a id="opIdAuthenticateUserByName"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Users/AuthenticateByName \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "Password": "string",
    "Pw": "string",
    "Username": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /Users/AuthenticateByName`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "Password": "string",
  "Pw": "string",
  "Username": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="authenticates-a-user-by-name-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[AuthenticateUserByName](#schemaauthenticateuserbyname)|true|The M:Jellyfin.Api.Controllers.UserController.AuthenticateUserByName(Jellyfin.Api.Models.UserDtos.AuthenticateUserByName) request.|
|» Password|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the sha1-hashed password.|
|» Pw|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the plain text password.|
|» Username|body|string \| null|false|Gets or sets the username.|

## Authenticates a user with quick connect.

<a id="opIdAuthenticateWithQuickConnect"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Users/AuthenticateWithQuickConnect \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "Token": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /Users/AuthenticateWithQuickConnect`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "Token": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="authenticates-a-user-with-quick-connect-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[QuickConnectDto](#schemaquickconnectdto)|true|The Jellyfin.Api.Models.UserDtos.QuickConnectDto request.|
|» Token|body|string|true|Gets or sets the quick connect token.|

## Initiates the forgot password process for a local user.

<a id="opIdForgotPassword"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Users/ForgotPassword \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "EnteredUsername": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /Users/ForgotPassword`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "EnteredUsername": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="initiates-the-forgot-password-process-for-a-local-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[ForgotPasswordDto](#schemaforgotpassworddto)|true|The forgot password request containing the entered username.|
|» EnteredUsername|body|string|true|Gets or sets the entered username to have its password reset.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Action": "ContactAdmin",
  "PinExpirationDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "PinFile": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="initiates-the-forgot-password-process-for-a-local-user-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Password reset process started.|[ForgotPasswordResult](#schemaforgotpasswordresult)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Redeems a forgot password pin.

<a id="opIdForgotPasswordPin"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Users/ForgotPassword/Pin \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '"string"'
```

`POST /Users/ForgotPassword/Pin`

> Body parameter

```json
"string"
```

<h3 id="redeems-a-forgot-password-pin-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|string \| null|false|The pin.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Success": true,
  "UsersReset": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="redeems-a-forgot-password-pin-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Pin reset process started.|[PinRedeemResult](#schemapinredeemresult)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Gets latest media.

<a id="opIdGetLatestMedia"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Users/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Items/Latest \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Users/{userId}/Items/Latest`

<h3 id="gets-latest-media-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string(uuid)|true|User id.|
|parentId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.|
|fields|query|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.|
|includeItemTypes|query|[string]|false|Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|
|isPlayed|query|boolean \| null|false|Filter by items that are played, or not.|
|enableImages|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. include image information in output.|
|imageTypeLimit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. the max number of images to return, per image type.|
|enableImageTypes|query|[[ImageType](#schemaimagetype)]|false|Optional. The image types to include in the output.|
|enableUserData|query|boolean \| null|false|Optional. include user data.|
|limit|query|integer(int32)|false|Return item limit.|
|groupItems|query|boolean|false|Whether or not to group items into a parent container.|

<h3 id="gets-the-root-folder-from-a-users-library-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Root folder returned.|[BaseItemDto](#schemabaseitemdto)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets an item from a user's library.

<a id="opIdGetItem"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Users/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Items/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Users/{userId}/Items/{itemId}`

<h3 id="gets-an-item-from-a-users-library-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string(uuid)|true|User id.|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|Item id.|

## Updates a user's rating for an item.

<a id="opIdUpdateUserItemRating"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Users/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Items/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Rating \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /Users/{userId}/Items/{itemId}/Rating`

<h3 id="updates-a-users-rating-for-an-item-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string(uuid)|true|User id.|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|Item id.|
|likes|query|boolean \| null|false|Whether this M:Jellyfin.Api.Controllers.UserLibraryController.UpdateUserItemRating(System.Guid,System.Guid,System.Nullable{System.Boolean}) is likes.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "IsFavorite": true,
  "ItemId": "string",
  "Key": "string",
  "LastPlayedDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "Likes": true,
  "PlayCount": 0,
  "PlaybackPositionTicks": 0,
  "Played": true,
  "PlayedPercentage": 0,
  "Rating": 0,
  "UnplayedItemCount": 0
}
```

<h3 id="updates-a-users-rating-for-an-item-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Item rating updated.|[UserItemDataDto](#schemauseritemdatadto)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Get user view grouping options.

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Users/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/GroupingOptions \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /Users/{userId}/GroupingOptions`

<h3 id="get-user-view-grouping-options-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string(uuid)|true|User id.|

```json
[
  {
    "Id": "string",
    "Name": "string"
  }
]
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "detail": "string",
  "instance": "string",
  "status": 0,
  "title": "string",
  "type": "string",
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|User view grouping options returned.|Inline|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Get user views.

<a id="opIdGetUserViews"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Users/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Views \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /Users/{userId}/Views`

<h3 id="get-user-views-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string(uuid)|true|User id.|
|includeExternalContent|query|boolean \| null|false|Whether or not to include external views such as channels or live tv.|
|presetViews|query|[string]|false|Preset views.|
|includeHidden|query|boolean|false|Whether or not to include hidden content.|

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-suggestions">Suggestions</h1>

## Gets suggestions.

<a id="opIdGetSuggestions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Users/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/Suggestions \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

|type|query|[string]|false|The type.|
|startIndex|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. The start index.|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-videos">Videos</h1>

## Merges videos into a single record.

<a id="opIdMergeVersions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/Videos/MergeVersions?ids=497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /Videos/MergeVersions`

<h3 id="merges-videos-into-a-single-record-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ids|query|[string(uuid)]|true|Item id list. This allows multiple, comma delimited.|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "detail": "string",
  "instance": "string",
  "status": 0,
  "title": "string",
  "type": "string",
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
}
```

<h3 id="merges-videos-into-a-single-record-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Videos merged.|None|
|400|Bad Request|Supply at least 2 video ids.|[ProblemDetails](#schemaproblemdetails)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
CustomAuthentication
</aside>

## Gets additional parts for a video.

<a id="opIdGetAdditionalPart"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Videos/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/AdditionalParts \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Videos/{itemId}/AdditionalParts`

<h3 id="gets-additional-parts-for-a-video-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|path|string(uuid)|true|The item id.|
|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.|

|videoBitRate|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Optional. Specify a video bitrate to encode to, e.g. 500000. If omitted this will be left to encoder defaults.|

<h1 id="jellyfin-api-years">Years</h1>

<a id="opIdGetYears"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Years \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "X-Emby-Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /Years`

<h3 id="get-years-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|userId|query|string(uuid) \| null|false|User Id.|
|recursive|query|boolean|false|Search recursively.|

```json
{
```

```json
  "status": 0,

  "type": "string",
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
}
```

# Schemas

<h2 id="tocS_AccessSchedule">AccessSchedule</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaaccessschedule"></a>
<a id="schema_AccessSchedule"></a>
<a id="tocSaccessschedule"></a>
<a id="tocsaccessschedule"></a>

```json
{
  "DayOfWeek": "Sunday",
  "EndHour": 0,
  "Id": 0,
  "StartHour": 0,
  "UserId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
}
```

An entity representing a user's access schedule.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|DayOfWeek|[DynamicDayOfWeek](#schemadynamicdayofweek)|true|none|An enum that represents a day of the week, weekdays, weekends, or all days.|
|EndHour|number(double)|true|none|Gets or sets the end hour.|
|Id|integer(int32)|true|read-only|Gets or sets the id of this instance.|
|StartHour|number(double)|true|none|Gets or sets the start hour.|

|EnableImages|boolean \| null|false|none|Gets or sets include image information in output.<br>Optional.|
|EnableTotalRecordCount|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether retrieve total record count.|
|EnableUserData|boolean \| null|false|none|Gets or sets include user data.<br>Optional.|
|Fields|[[ItemFields](#schemaitemfields)]|false|none|Gets or sets specify additional fields of information to return in the output. This allows multiple, comma delimited. Options: Budget, Chapters, DateCreated, Genres, HomePageUrl, IndexOptions, MediaStreams, Overview, ParentId, Path, People, ProviderIds, PrimaryImageAspectRatio, Revenue, SortName, Studios, Taglines.<br>Optional.|
|GenreIds|[string(uuid)]|false|none|Gets or sets the genre ids to return guide information for.|
|Genres|[string]|false|none|Gets or sets the genres to return guide information for.|
|HasAired|boolean \| null|false|none|Gets or sets filter by programs that have completed airing, or not.<br>Optional.|
|ImageTypeLimit|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the max number of images to return, per image type.<br>Optional.|
|IsAiring|boolean \| null|false|none|Gets or sets filter by programs that are currently airing, or not.<br>Optional.|
|IsKids|boolean \| null|false|none|Gets or sets filter for kids.<br>Optional.|
|IsMovie|boolean \| null|false|none|Gets or sets filter for movies.<br>Optional.|
|IsNews|boolean \| null|false|none|Gets or sets filter for news.<br>Optional.|
|IsSeries|boolean \| null|false|none|Gets or sets filter for series.<br>Optional.|
|IsSports|boolean \| null|false|none|Gets or sets filter for sports.<br>Optional.|
|LibrarySeriesId|string(uuid)|false|none|Gets or sets filter by library series id.<br>Optional.|
|Limit|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the maximum number of records to return.<br>Optional.|
|MaxEndDate|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the maximum premiere end date.<br>Optional.|
|MaxStartDate|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the maximum premiere start date.<br>Optional.|
|MinEndDate|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the minimum premiere end date.<br>Optional.|
|MinStartDate|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the minimum premiere start date.<br>Optional.|
|SeriesTimerId|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets filter by series timer id.<br>Optional.|
|SortBy|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited. Options: Name, StartDate.<br>Optional.|
|SortOrder|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets sort Order - Ascending,Descending.|
|StartIndex|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.<br>Optional.|
|UserId|string(uuid)|false|none|Gets or sets optional. Filter by user id.|

|EnableSlowResponseWarning|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether slow server responses should be logged as a warning.|
|EnableUPnP|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable automatic port forwarding.|

|ImageSavingConvention|[ImageSavingConvention](#schemaimagesavingconvention)|false|none|none|
|IsPortAuthorized|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is port authorized.|

|LibraryMetadataRefreshConcurrency|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the how many metadata refreshes can run concurrently.|

It involves the creation of several<br>different directories and files.|
|LibraryScanFanoutConcurrency|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the how the library scan fans out.|

|LocalNetworkSubnets|[string]|false|none|Gets or sets the subnets that are deemed to make up the LAN.|
|LogFileRetentionDays|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the number of days we should retain log files.|

|MetadataNetworkPath|string \| null|false|none|none|

|MetadataPath|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the metadata path.|

|MinResumeDurationSeconds|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the minimum duration that an item must have in order to be eligible for playstate updates..|
|MinResumePct|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the minimum percentage of an item that must be played in order for playstate to be updated.|
|PathSubstitutions|[[PathSubstitution](#schemapathsubstitution)]|false|none|none|
|PluginRepositories|[[RepositoryInfo](#schemarepositoryinfo)]|false|none|none|
|PreferredMetadataLanguage|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the preferred metadata language.|
|PreviousVersion|[Version](#schemaversion)|false|none|none|
|PreviousVersionStr|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the stringified PreviousVersion to be stored/loaded,<br>because System.Version itself isn't xml-serializable.|
|PublicHttpsPort|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the public HTTPS port.|
|PublicPort|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the public mapped port.|
|PublishedServerUriBySubnet|[string]|false|none|Gets or sets PublishedServerUri to advertise for specific subnets.|
|QuickConnectAvailable|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether quick connect is available for use on this server.|
|RemoteClientBitrateLimit|integer(int32)|false|none|none|
|RemoteIPFilter|[string]|false|none|Gets or sets the filter for remote IP connectivity. Used in conjuntion with <seealso cref="P:MediaBrowser.Model.Configuration.ServerConfiguration.IsRemoteIPFilterBlacklist" />.|
|RemoveOldPlugins|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether older plugins should automatically be deleted from the plugin folder.|
|RequireHttps|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether the server should force connections over HTTPS.|
|SSDPTracingFilter|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether an IP address is to be used to filter the detailed ssdp logs that are being sent to the console/log.<br>If the setting "Emby.Dlna": "Debug" msut be set in logging.default.json for this property to work.|
|SaveMetadataHidden|boolean|false|none|none|
|ServerName|string \| null|false|none|none|
|SkipDeserializationForBasicTypes|boolean|false|none|none|
|SlowResponseThresholdMs|integer(int64)|false|none|Gets or sets the threshold for the slow response time warning in ms.|
|SortRemoveCharacters|[string]|false|none|Gets or sets characters to be removed from strings to create a sort name.|
|SortRemoveWords|[string]|false|none|Gets or sets words to be removed from strings to create a sort name.|
|SortReplaceCharacters|[string]|false|none|Gets or sets characters to be replaced with a ' ' in strings to create a sort name.|
|TrustAllIP6Interfaces|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether all IPv6 interfaces should be treated as on the internal network.<br>Depending on the address range implemented ULA ranges might not be used.|
|UDPPortRange|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets client udp port range.|
|UDPSendCount|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the number of times SSDP UDP messages are sent.|
|UDPSendDelay|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the delay between each groups of SSDP messages (in ms).|
|UICulture|string \| null|false|none|none|
|UPnPCreateHttpPortMap|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether the http port should be mapped as part of UPnP automatic port forwarding.|
|UninstalledPlugins|[string]|false|none|none|
|VirtualInterfaceNames|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating the interfaces that should be ignored. The list can be comma separated. <seealso cref="P:MediaBrowser.Model.Configuration.ServerConfiguration.IgnoreVirtualInterfaces" />.|

|Type|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the type.|

|ExternalProgramId|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the external program identifier.|
|ExternalSeriesTimerId|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the external series timer identifier.|
|Id|string \| null|false|none|Id of the recording.|
|IsPostPaddingRequired|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is post padding required.|
|IsPrePaddingRequired|boolean|false|none|Gets or sets a value indicating whether this instance is pre padding required.|
|KeepUntil|[KeepUntil](#schemakeepuntil)|false|none|none|
|Name|string \| null|false|none|Name of the recording.|
|Overview|string \| null|false|none|Description of the recording.|
|ParentBackdropImageTags|[string]|false|none|Gets or sets the parent backdrop image tags.|
|ParentBackdropItemId|string \| null|false|none|If the item does not have any backdrops, this will hold the Id of the Parent that has one.|
|PostPaddingSeconds|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the post padding seconds.|
|PrePaddingSeconds|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the pre padding seconds.|
|Priority|integer(int32)|false|none|Gets or sets the priority.|
|ProgramId|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the program identifier.|

|SeriesTimerId|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the series timer identifier.|
|ServerId|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the server identifier.|
|ServiceName|string \| null|false|none|Gets or sets the name of the service.|
|StartDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The start date of the recording, in UTC.|
|Status|[RecordingStatus](#schemarecordingstatus)|false|none|none|
|Type|string \| null|false|none|none|
